note: City of New Lisbon park on Hog Island Road where the Lemonweir River enters New Lisbon Lake, with a boat launch, two fishing piers, a multi-purpose trail, pavilions and a playground; tent camping is in a separate area. The sites with open grass to the river channel are 48-54 on the west row, about 25-40 m from the water across the trail. --Claude
summary: City page, campground map and HeyGov booking API read. Real municipal campground: 56 numbered sites on the map/engine (city text says 50), online booking via HeyGov or office permit/self-registration, showers, dump, potable water. Riverfront kept with a caveat naming west-row sites 48-54. Phone empty -> 608-562-3534. Rates and hookups not readable (engine archived for the off-season).
flags: WATERFRONT 'riverfront' kept with a caveat: the city map puts sites 48-54 on the west row beside the multi-purpose trail and two fishing piers, with the water ('New Lisbon Lake', the Lemonweir's flowage channel) beyond. On Esri imagery the channel there (about 43.8822,-90.1610) is roughly 35-40 m wide and the west-row pads sit about 25-40 m from it across open grass and the trail, with only scattered trees. The north side of the loops (sites 37, 55, 56) faces cattail marsh, not open water (view at most). All 56 sites are bookable venues in the city's engine (nightly). The channel width is near the 30 m creekside line; reviewer may prefer creekside.
PHONE empty -> 608-562-3534 (city campground map 'Phone: 608-562-3534'; Google the same). City Hall is (608) 562-5213.

SITES: the city page says '50 clean and spacious campsites'; the map numbers sites 1-56 plus 'North Loop campsites' and a tent-only area, and the HeyGov engine lists Site 01-Site 56. Stored count 50 (derived) left; reviewer may prefer 56.
